metadata.population: All accepted flights; no tail or rotation availability requirement
metadata.test_interpretation: Exploratory reuse of previously inspected 2025. Tail-linked population is retrospective and selected.
metadata.sample_size_definition: Number of held-out flights. The historical EB sample size is reported separately.
metadata.delay_causes_definition: Shares of reported delay minutes among held-out delayed flights.
metadata.matrix_scope: Route pairs selectable in Visual.html, or top observed routes for a custom dataset without those airports.
metadata.interval_definition: Historical empirical Bayes intervals for delay probability.
